title: Dante
html_source:
Its interesting how great artists, and not just artists, seep into our consciousness mundanely and passively throughout our youth, only to become firmly embedded and important. Joyce knew the name Dante long before he begin reading him. The root back from flower to seed was an association with the word Auntie.

Or this is just a pointless reference to the great poet!
